Checks.Name: d=1: F_is_harmonic
Checks.Detail: The normalized cubic has zero Euclidean Laplacian.

Checks.Name: d=1: normalized_Hsiang_equation
Checks.Detail: The exact normalized Hsiang identity is L[F]=-q F.

Checks.Name: d=1: D_equals_a_plus_p
Checks.Detail: D=Gamma(r,F)=a+p by independent differentiation.

Checks.Name: d=1: recover_r
Checks.Detail: Both the q formula and Delta[S] formula recover r.

Checks.Name: d=1: recover_s
Checks.Detail: Both the q formula and Delta[S] formula recover s.

Checks.Name: d=1: recover_p
Checks.Detail: The cubic and D recover p=3 F-D/2.

Checks.Name: d=1: recover_a
Checks.Detail: The cubic and D recover a=3 D/2-3 F.

Checks.Name: d=1: recover_h
Checks.Detail: Independent differentiation recovers h=(Gamma(a,p)+r s)/18.

Checks.Name: d=1: rank_five_exact_minor
Checks.Detail: At Z=diag(1,-1,0), u=(1,1,1), the rows (r,a,s,p,h) and columns (x,z,u1,u2,u3) give the nonzero exact minor 4 Sqrt[3]/3.
